property_summary: For any call to transfer that does not revert, the external call to caddress with the transferFrom selector must use from as sender and _tos[i] as recipient; the mutant swaps them, causing a revert when a helper contract enforces correct argument order, so the function's return success flag differs.
change_summary: Replace 'caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v))' with 'caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, _tos[i], from, v))' to swap sender and recipient.
